competencies.name: Pacemaker potential
competencies.can: Explain the unstable pacemaker potential of the sinoatrial node by the funny current, calcium entry, and potassium exit and state what sets intrinsic heart rate.

competencies.name: Contractile cell action potential
competencies.can: Diagram the ventricular action potential and identify the ion movement responsible for the rapid upstroke, the plateau, and repolarization.

competencies.name: Conduction system
competencies.can: Trace an impulse through the sinoatrial node, internodal pathways, atrioventricular node, bundle of His, bundle branches, and Purkinje fibers and explain the purpose of the atrioventricular delay.

competencies.name: Cardiac refractory period
competencies.can: Explain why the long refractory period of cardiac muscle prevents tetanus and why that matters for pump function.

competencies.name: ECG waves and intervals
competencies.can: Label the P wave, QRS complex, T wave, PR interval, and QT interval and state the electrical event each represents.

competencies.name: ECG interpretation
competencies.can: Calculate heart rate from an ECG strip and identify sinus rhythm, tachycardia, bradycardia, and a first degree or complete heart block.

competencies.name: ECG recording
competencies.can: Record a lead II ECG, measure the intervals, and correlate each wave with the mechanical event that follows it.
